conflicts.permit: Our app may use this permission to get your IMEI as your device ID, so we can provide better service for you.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not collect Personal Information.
conflicts.situation: When the app obtains the user's IMEI / unique device identifier stored on the device.
conflicts.reason: The policy defines Personal Information to include 'information stored within your Device' and blanketly denies collecting Personal Information, yet directly states it obtains the IMEI.
